_doc: Combat balance (voice-rpg-engine docs/GAME_CREATION_GUIDE.md, section 3). Fights are balanced for a sensible player at balanceResonance; BalanceContractTest reports every story fight against the targets in app/build/reports/balance.txt, and the enemy HP/attack in encounters.json come from BalanceTunerTest. Set enforce to 1 to make the targets fail the build.
